description: Angular component for a shape fill stripe settings panel, allowing users to configure stripe fill properties for map shapes, with preview generation and event handling.

classes.name: ShapeFillStripeSettingsPanelComponent
classes.description: Angular component for configuring stripe fill settings on map shapes, including form controls, preview rendering, and event emission.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group with current settings and sets up value change subscription for live preview updates.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Hides the popover without applying changes.

methods.name: applyShapeFillStripeSettings
methods.description: Emits the updated settings and hides the popover.

methods.name: updatePreview
methods.description: Generates a preview URL for the stripe pattern and updates the background style for preview display.
